rules.fatigue: drowsiness only: explicit yawn OR causally observed sustained eyes_state/close; explicit open without yawn is a proxy negative; transitions, undefined and gaps are unknown. NOT a fatigue diagnosis.
rules.phone_use: distraction only: phonecall_left/right or texting_left/right positive; explicit safe_drive negative; conflicts/unclassified/unreviewed driver actions unknown.
rules.drinking: distraction only: explicit drinking positive; explicit safe_drive negative; conflicts/unclassified/unreviewed driver actions unknown.
rules.distraction: distraction only: gaze_on_road/not_looking_road positive and looking_road negative; a road-attention proxy, NOT a dangerous-distraction diagnosis. gaze_zone is not mapped.

unknown_policy: target=0, label_mask=0; never infer a negative from missing annotation
sampling: 25Hz latest-past source frame, source age <=80ms; inclusive source intervals; window endpoint supervision
alignment: annotation_frame = decoded_frame_index + frame_shift - min(all three frame_shifts); face reference shift must be zero
